item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 30/Aug/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak over Guangdong in the next couple of days, and showers and thunderstorms triggered by high temperatures will also affect the region. Under the influence of a dry continental airstream, it will be generally fine and persistently very hot over southern China towards the weekend and early next week. An easterly airstream is expected to bring showers to the coast of Guangdong midweek next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Hinnamnor will move towards the vicinity of the Ryukyu Islands in the next couple of days, then linger over the seas east of Taiwan in the following couple of days.
